name: NTR Summer in Moongrove Bay
source:
Summer in Moongrove Bay is a choice-driven Visual Novel that follows Alex and his girlfriend Luna as they embark on a student exchange program in a foreign country, hoping to make unforgettable summer memories together.
With new friendships, charming strangers, and potential love interests around every corner, both of them may find themselves growing closer to people they never expected to meet. As Luna forms new bonds and Alex discovers connections of his own, their relationship may face unexpected challenges.
